t: A keyboard music computer that loads patches to become a synth, sampler, or effect.
steps: Buy an Organelle S2 from Critter and Guitari or a US music store for $499. It ships with a power supply and a USB Wi-Fi adapter.
Plug in the 9 volt power supply. Use only a 9 V, 1 A, center-positive supply.
Turn the selector knob to load a factory patch. Play the keys and turn the four knobs.
Switch the input to line-in before trying effect patches. This avoids microphone feedback.
Plug in the Wi-Fi adapter and open the built-in web editor from a laptop.
Download more patches from the official patch library.
Read the Organelle programming guide and try a Faust and Lua patch.
meta: Open Code. From $499. A few stores.
